evals.prompt: The map of this project has nodes with no description. Describe them.
evals.expected_output: Descriptions written from the code at each node's location, in the project's .periplus/descriptions.yaml.
expectations: Reads the code at a node's location before describing it
Writes entries under nodes in .periplus/descriptions.yaml, keyed by node id

evals.prompt: Add a description for the node of a class that has no location in the map.
evals.expected_output: The answer says the code for that node is not in the mapped files, and writes no description that guesses what the class does.
expectations: Checks the node's state and location first
Invents no behaviour for code it could not read
